channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump intensifies trade war, moves to ban many Canadian goods from US
item.description: President Donald Trump has increased economic pressure on Canada in response to its retaliatory tariffs against the U.S.

item.title: Shelton defeats Alcaraz in late-night US Open marathon, advances to face Tiafoe
item.description: Ben Shelton ended Carlos Alcaraz's title defense in the latest-finishing match in U.S. Open history, winning 6-7, 6-1, 6-3, 1-6, 7-6.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy juror discusses mistrial, cites significant doubt
item.description: A juror in Lindsay Clancy's trial shared insights into deliberations, noting that too much doubt prevented a guilty verdict.

item.title: Oil prices reach $100 per barrel amid fresh US-Iran attacks
item.description: Crude oil hit a seven-week high after the U.S. reported destroying five more Iranian tankers, prompting Iranian retaliation.
